values.TIP: Cylinder head bolt: First, tighten the cylinder head bolts to 40 N·m (4.0 kgf·m, 30 lb·ft) in the proper tightening sequence and remove them. values.Idling condition > Exhaust gas sampling: Sampling port on the exhaust pipe
values.Idle adjustment at altitude: Because the air pressure is lower at high altitudes, the air-fuel mixture will become richer. If the idling speed is low, turn the idle screw clockwise to increase the speed before the adjustment. Adjust idle with the starter knob pulled in completely, after warm-up (coolant temperature measured with the Yamaha diagnostic tool).
values.Power Tuner app: Download the Power Tuner app (Google/Apple store) to a smartphone and connect wirelessly to the CCU (Communication Control Unit) wireless network to adjust various vehicle settings; first connection requires removing the left side cover and recording the CCU serial number, then entering it within two minutes after the start switch is pressed or while the engine runs.
values.Power Tuner NOTICE: The application is designed for adjusting the settings on a standard vehicle. In case the engine specifications (muffler, compression ratio, etc.) have been changed, the performance may not match to the actual settings.
values.Drive mode switch: Push the mode switch (in neutral, engine running) to change between drive mode 1 and drive mode 2. Mode 1: all-around good engine power and throttle response. Mode 2: milder throttle response for riding technical sections. Indicator light illuminates blue when mode 2 is selected (blinks blue once every 4 s for mode 1 when ECU active with engine stopped).
values.Lap time record mode: Activated from the Power Tuner app; mode switch starts/advances lap timing; drive mode cannot be changed while in lap time record mode; results received and saved in the app.

records.notes: The extract's tuning chapter covers chassis only (sprockets, tire pressure, fork/shock setting); no fuel/ignition map tables are printed. ECU/mode content is from the manual's General Information chapter (included parts / instrument and control functions) in the full PDF.

values.Shock symptom: Stiff travel: High compression damping: turn counterclockwise (about 1/6 turn) to decrease; spring set length: 90–100 mm (3.5–3.9 in) sunken length; spring: replace with soft spring
values.Gearing guidance: Secondary reduction ratio = rear sprocket teeth / drive sprocket teeth. records.statement: Yamaha's 2024 WR450F owner's service manual lists the WR450F as an off-road-only machine that is illegal to ride on public streets, roads or highways, with a federal/state/Environment Canada emission control label and an odometer-based emission-control maintenance chart; it says nothing about a throttle stop, exhaust insert or competition kit.

values.Use restriction (safety information): This motorcycle is designed for off-road use only, therefore, it is illegal to operate it on public streets, roads, or highways, even a dirt or gravel one. Off-road use on public lands may be illegal. Please check local regulations before riding.
values.Emissions compliance statement: The design and manufacture of this Yamaha machine fully comply with the emissions standards for clean air applicable at the date of manufacture; follow the recommended maintenance schedules to maintain these standards.
values.Vehicle Emission Control Information lab: Label shows specifications related to exhaust emissions as required by federal law, state law and Environment Canada.
values.California Proposition 65 warning: Operating, servicing and maintaining a passenger vehicle or off-road vehicle can expose you to chemicals including engine exhaust, carbon monoxide, phthalates, and lead, known to the State of California to cause cancer and birth defects or other reproductive harm (www.P65Warnings.ca.gov/passenger-vehicle).
values.Emission control periodic maintenance ch: Fuel line, spark plug, valve clearance, air filter, breather system, fuel injection idle speed, exhaust system, engine oil and filter at 600 mi (1000 km)/1 month, 1800 mi (3000 km)/3 months, 3000 mi (5000 km)/6 months, repeating from 4200 mi (7000 km)/9 months; asterisked items are dealer jobs.
values.Spark arrester: Fitted in the silencer; clean per the general maintenance chart (remove silencer cap screws and spark arrester bolts, tap out carbon, wire-brush, refit with a new gasket). Spark arrester bolt torque: 5 N·m (0.5 kgf·m, 3.7 lb·ft).
values.Aftermarket parts and modifications: Yamaha can neither endorse nor recommend accessories not sold by Yamaha or modifications not specifically recommended by Yamaha; modifications that change design or operation characteristics can increase risk and the owner is responsible for injuries related to changes.
values.ECU tuning hardware: Power Tuner smartphone app via the CCU; NOTICE that settings assume a standard vehicle and may not match if muffler, compression ratio, etc. have been changed.
values.Throttle stop / exhaust insert / competi: Not mentioned anywhere in this manual (full-PDF text search for throttle stop, insert, restrictor, competition kit, GYTR kit, dB returned no such content).

values.Idle adjustment at altitude: Because the air pressure is lower at high altitudes, the air-fuel mixture will become richer. If the idling speed is low, turn the idle screw clockwise to increase the speed before the adjustment. Adjust idle with the starter knob pulled in completely, after warm-up (coolant temperature measured with the Yamaha diagnostic tool).
values.Power Tuner app: Download the Power Tuner app (Google/Apple store) to a smartphone and connect wirelessly to the CCU (Communication Control Unit) wireless network to adjust various vehicle settings; first connection requires removing the left side cover and recording the CCU serial number, then entering it within two minutes after the start switch is pressed or while the engine runs.
values.Power Tuner NOTICE: The application is designed for adjusting the settings on a standard vehicle. In case the engine specifications (muffler, compression ratio, etc.) have been changed, the performance may not match to the actual settings.
values.Drive mode switch: Push the mode switch (in neutral, engine running) to change between drive mode 1 and drive mode 2. Mode 1: all-around good engine power and throttle response. Mode 2: milder throttle response for riding technical sections. Indicator light illuminates blue when mode 2 is selected (blinks blue once every 4 s for mode 1 when ECU active with engine stopped).
values.Lap time record mode: Activated from the Power Tuner app; mode switch starts/advances lap timing; drive mode cannot be changed while in lap time record mode; results received and saved in the app.

values.Gearing guidance: Secondary reduction ratio = rear sprocket teeth / drive sprocket teeth. records.statement: Yamaha's 2025 WR450F owner's service manual lists the WR450F as an off-road-only machine that is illegal to ride on public streets, roads or highways, with a federal/state/Environment Canada emission control label and an odometer-based emission-control maintenance chart; it says nothing about a throttle stop, exhaust insert or competition kit.

values.Use restriction (safety information): This motorcycle is designed for off-road use only, therefore, it is illegal to operate it on public streets, roads, or highways, even a dirt or gravel one. Off-road use on public lands may be illegal. Please check local regulations before riding.
values.Emissions compliance statement: The design and manufacture of this Yamaha machine fully comply with the emissions standards for clean air applicable at the date of manufacture; follow the recommended maintenance schedules to maintain these standards.
values.Vehicle Emission Control Information lab: Label shows specifications related to exhaust emissions as required by federal law, state law and Environment Canada.
values.California Proposition 65 warning: Operating, servicing and maintaining a passenger vehicle or off-road vehicle can expose you to chemicals including engine exhaust, carbon monoxide, phthalates, and lead, known to the State of California to cause cancer and birth defects or other reproductive harm (www.P65Warnings.ca.gov/passenger-vehicle).
values.Emission control periodic maintenance ch: Fuel line, spark plug, valve clearance, air filter, breather system, fuel injection idle speed, exhaust system, engine oil and filter at 600 mi (1000 km)/1 month, 1800 mi (3000 km)/3 months, 3000 mi (5000 km)/6 months, repeating from 4200 mi (7000 km)/9 months; asterisked items are dealer jobs.
values.Spark arrester: Fitted in the silencer; clean per the general maintenance chart (remove silencer cap screws and spark arrester bolts, tap out carbon, wire-brush, refit with a new gasket). Spark arrester bolt torque: 5 N·m (0.5 kgf·m, 3.7 lb·ft).
values.Aftermarket parts and modifications: Yamaha can neither endorse nor recommend accessories not sold by Yamaha or modifications not specifically recommended by Yamaha; modifications that change design or operation characteristics can increase risk and the owner is responsible for injuries related to changes.
values.ECU tuning hardware: Power Tuner smartphone app via the CCU; NOTICE that settings assume a standard vehicle and may not match if muffler, compression ratio, etc. have been changed.
values.Throttle stop / exhaust insert / competi: Not mentioned anywhere in this manual (full-PDF text search for throttle stop, insert, restrictor, competition kit, GYTR kit, dB returned no such content).

records.notes: This is the U.S.-market owner's service manual (WR450FM wiring diagram/cover code in 2021). No road-legal (street-registered) configuration, throttle-stop screw, exhaust restrictor insert or de-restriction/competition kit is described; ECU adjustment is limited to the Power Tuner (optional GYTR unit for 2021/2023, smartphone app from 2024). Forgotten password = ECU replacement for a fee; nobody, including the Yamaha dealer, can remove or change the password without it; remove the password before transferring the vehicle. values.Idle adjustment at altitude: Because the air pressure is lower at high altitudes, the air-fuel mixture will become richer. If the idling speed is low, turn the idle screw clockwise to increase the speed before the adjustment. Adjust idle with the starter knob pulled in completely, after warm-up (coolant temperature measured with the Yamaha diagnostic tool).
values.Power Tuner app: Download the Power Tuner app (Google/Apple store) to a smartphone and connect wirelessly to the CCU (Communication Control Unit) wireless network to adjust various vehicle settings; first connection requires removing the left side cover and recording the CCU serial number, then entering it within two minutes after the start switch is pressed or while the engine runs.
values.Power Tuner NOTICE: The application is designed for adjusting the settings on a standard vehicle. In case the engine specifications (muffler, compression ratio, etc.) have been changed, the performance may not match to the actual settings.
values.Map change: Push the multi-function button (in neutral, engine running) to change between map 1 and map 2. Map 1: all-around good engine power and throttle response. Map 2: milder throttle response for riding technical sections. Indicator light illuminates blue when map 2 is selected.
values.Lap time record mode: Activated from the Power Tuner app; map cannot be changed while in lap time record mode.
values.ECU lock function: No physical key; the ECU can be locked from the Power Tuner app to immobilize the vehicle. Password 8–20 characters (upper/lower case letters, numbers, symbols; 10+ characters with 3+ character types recommended). If locked, the indicator on the left handlebar switch blinks blue twice on a start attempt and the starter may turn without the engine starting. Forgotten password = ECU replacement for a fee; nobody, including the Yamaha dealer, can remove or change the password without it; remove the password before transferring the vehicle. If no password is set, someone else could set one without permission.

records.statement: Yamaha's 2027 WR450F owner's service manual lists the WR450F as an off-road-only machine that is illegal to ride on public streets, roads or highways, with a federal/state/Environment Canada emission control label and an odometer-based emission-control maintenance chart; it says nothing about a throttle stop, exhaust insert or competition kit.

values.Use restriction (safety information): This motorcycle is designed for off-road use only, therefore, it is illegal to operate it on public streets, roads, or highways, even a dirt or gravel one. Off-road use on public lands may be illegal. Please check local regulations before riding.
values.Emissions compliance statement: The design and manufacture of this Yamaha machine fully comply with the emissions standards for clean air applicable at the date of manufacture; follow the recommended maintenance schedules to maintain these standards.
values.Vehicle Emission Control Information lab: Label shows specifications related to exhaust emissions as required by federal law, state law and Environment Canada.
values.California Proposition 65 warning: Operating, servicing and maintaining a passenger vehicle or off-road vehicle can expose you to chemicals including engine exhaust, carbon monoxide, phthalates, and lead, known to the State of California to cause cancer and birth defects or other reproductive harm (www.P65Warnings.ca.gov/passenger-vehicle).
values.Emission control periodic maintenance ch: Fuel line, spark plug, valve clearance, air filter, breather system, fuel injection idle speed, exhaust system, engine oil and filter at 600 mi (1000 km)/1 month, 1800 mi (3000 km)/3 months, 3000 mi (5000 km)/6 months, repeating from 4200 mi (7000 km)/9 months; asterisked items are dealer jobs.
values.Spark arrester: Fitted in the silencer; clean per the general maintenance chart (remove silencer cap screws and spark arrester bolts, tap out carbon, wire-brush, refit with a new gasket). Spark arrester bolt torque: 5 N·m (0.5 kgf·m, 3.7 lb·ft).
values.Aftermarket parts and modifications: Yamaha can neither endorse nor recommend accessories not sold by Yamaha or modifications not specifically recommended by Yamaha; modifications that change design or operation characteristics can increase risk and the owner is responsible for injuries related to changes.
values.ECU tuning hardware: Power Tuner smartphone app via the CCU; NOTICE that settings assume a standard vehicle and may not match if muffler, compression ratio, etc. have been changed.
values.Selectable engine modes: Map 1 / map 2 (multi-function button) plus app ECU lock (immobilizer)
values.Throttle stop / exhaust insert / competi: Not mentioned anywhere in this manual (full-PDF text search for throttle stop, insert, restrictor, competition kit, GYTR kit, dB returned no such content).

records.notes: This is the U.S.-market owner's service manual (WR450FM wiring diagram/cover code in 2021). No road-legal (street-registered) configuration, throttle-stop screw, exhaust restrictor insert or de-restriction/competition kit is described; ECU adjustment is limited to the Power Tuner (optional GYTR unit for 2021/2023, smartphone app from 2024). Quoted text paraphrased only where noted.

conflicts.topic: 2027 WR450F fork standard oil amount outside its adjustment range
conflicts.detail: Yamaha's 2027 WR450F owner's service manual (DP4-2819U-10) tuning chapter prints a standard fork oil amount of 210 cm³ (7.10 US oz, 7.41 Imp.oz) while giving an extent of adjustment of 260–370 cm³ (8.79–12.51 US oz, 9.17–13.05 Imp.oz); earlier WR450F manuals print 285 cm³ standard within 260–365/370 cm³. Recorded as printed (verified on the page image, p.10-2); likely a misprint in one of the two values.

not_found.detail: Not mentioned in any of the six WR450F manuals (2021, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026, 2027); full-PDF text searched.
